subject: AWS Marketplace partner portal onboarding + co-sell playbook
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Sam Patel <sam@acme.ai>, Nina Alvarez <nina@acme.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-03-05T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: AWS Marketplace partner portal onboarding + co-sell playbook

Hi Sam / Nina —

Thanks again for the sync this morning. As discussed, we're aiming to have the AWS Marketplace listing staged in the partner portal and the co-sell enablement kit ready for the field by April 15, with public listing targeted for May 1. To keep momentum, please confirm the following items by end of week:

1) AMI access: do you have a shared S3/AMI ID and the account ID we should add to the seller console?
2) SKU mapping: which core SKU(s) map to the ACME.ai "Core" and "Enterprise" tiers — we need exact SKU IDs for the catalog entry.
3) Procurement contact: who will sign the Private Offer (if applicable)?
4) Demo slate: confirm 2–3 use-cases we can include in the co-sell demo package.

Attached is a draft listing copy + hero assets (redwood_aws_listing_draft.pdf) and a short template for the demo slate. I'll coordinate pricing footnotes with Kimberly once you share SKU IDs.

Proposed next steps:
- Sam: confirm AMI/account and upload metadata (by 3/9)
- Nina: share procurement contact and requirements (by 3/9)
- Marissa/Kimberly: finalize co-sell narrative and pricing footnotes (by 3/12)

If the dates look tight, we can push the staging milestone by 1 week, but getting AMI visibility early is the gating item.

Thanks!

--
Jonas Weber
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com
Phone: +1 415-555-0192

From: Sam Patel <sam@acme.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Nina Alvarez <nina@acme.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-03-05T11:24:00-07:00
Subject: Re: AWS Marketplace partner portal onboarding + co-sell playbook

Jonas —

Appreciate the clear checklist. Quick answers below and I've attached the MVP requirements spreadsheet (acme_mvp_requirements.xlsx).

1) AMI/account: AMI ID ami-0b7fae8c1d2b3c4a5 and our AWS account ID is 123456789012. We will grant the seller console access to the account you indicate; share the account/user to add and we'll accept.
2) SKU mapping: Proposing SKU-ACME-CORE (monthly) and SKU-ACME-ENT-ANNUAL (annual). If Redwood needs alternate naming, tell us and we'll adjust.
3) Procurement contact: procurement@acme.ai (procure@acme.ai) — Nina is looping them in. They expect a Private Offer template and standard SOW; procurement prefers DocuSign.
4) Demo slate: recommended use-cases are (a) real-time summarization for support tickets, (b) personalized recommendations on a product catalog, (c) secure document redaction for PII-sensitive content.

A couple of notes on licensing: our security team asked whether Redwood will include an allowed-region footnote for the AMI (we plan to host in us-east-1 and us-west-2). Also curious about whether you support BYO-model variants in the marketplace listing (we may want to call out optional BYO in the copy).

Happy to meet tomorrow at 10am PT to walk through the requirements if that helps.

Best,
Sam
VP Partnerships, ACME.ai
sam@acme.ai

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Sam Patel <sam@acme.ai>, Nina Alvarez <nina@acme.ai>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-03-05T14:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: AWS Marketplace partner portal onboarding + co-sell playbook

Thanks Sam — this is great detail and the sheet is helpful. Looping Kimberly on pricing footnotes and legal flags. A few operational asks from my side:

- Jonas: can you confirm who on our side will be the seller-console admin so ACME can grant AMI visibility? I can take the admin handoff but want to be explicit.
- Kimberly: please review the SKU names above. If we rename to RDW-ACME-CORE and RDW-ACME-ENT for catalog consistency, any objections? Kimberly, we also need your sign-off on the metering language (monthly vs. annual) and the "allowed regions" footnote Sam mentioned.
- Sam/Nina: for the Private Offer, please send the procurement contact's preferred contact and the typical PO timeline so we can align DocuSign and the HubSpot deal.

I've attached the draft listing copy (redwood_aws_listing_draft.pdf) — it's intentionally conservative on claims and includes a short section called "Co-sell field kit" that outlines the demo slate. If everyone is good, I'll push this to the partner portal as a staging draft and request AMI/account linkage.

Suggested next meeting: 3/6 at 10am PT to confirm AMI access and review pricing footnotes. Confirm if you can make that.

--
Marissa Cole
Product Marketing, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Sam Patel <sam@acme.ai>, Nina Alvarez <nina@acme.ai>, ACME.ai Procurement <procure@acme.ai>
Date: 2028-03-06T15:38:00-07:00
Subject: Re: AWS Marketplace partner portal onboarding + co-sell playbook

All —

Quick recap after today's check-in:

- AMI/account confirmed (ami-0b7fae8c1d2b3c4a5 / 123456789012). Marissa will be the seller-console admin for staging.
- SKUs: we'll normalize names to RDW-ACME-CORE and RDW-ACME-ENT in the catalog, mapping to the ACME IDs Sam provided. Kimberly: please confirm pricing footnote wording by tomorrow EOD.
- Procurement: procure@acme.ai is primary. Marissa to prepare Private Offer template; Sam to confirm PO timing.
- Demo slate: agreed on the three use-cases (support summarization, recommendations, redaction). Marissa to prepare two short videos and a 5-minute sample workflow per use-case for the co-sell kit.
- Legal/security: ACME asked for allowed-region language — we'll add an "Availability" footnote listing us-east-1 and us-west-2 for the AMI.

Action items and owners:
- Marissa: push listing draft to partner portal staging and attach redwood_aws_listing_draft.pdf; prepare Private Offer template (due 3/9).
- Kimberly: finalize pricing footnote and metering language (due 3/7).
- Sam/Nina: confirm procurement timeline and accept DocuSign Private Offer (tentative by 3/12).
- Jonas: publish co-sell playbook doc to HubSpot and share link (I'll drop the link in HubSpot once live).

Attachments: redwood_aws_listing_draft.pdf (listing copy), acme_mvp_requirements.xlsx (MVP details), docu_sign_proposal_link.txt (DocuSign prep link).

If nobody objects, I'll schedule the staging push for 3/10 and the internal field enablement review for 3/15.

Thanks everyone — strong momentum here.

Best,
Jonas
--
Jonas Weber
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com
